questions.q: What two beliefs does Obama say unite Americans?
a: Freedom and community
Faith and prosperity
Equality and security
Independence and tradition
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the Constitution and the Declaration both center on freedom and community.

questions.q: Which three outside forces does Obama say make a politician's job hard?
a: Money, the media and special interest groups
Voters, courts and foreign governments
Pollsters, unions and rivals
Lobbyists, family and staff
questions.why: Lesson 2 names money, the media and large interest groups as the main influences on politicians.

questions.q: Why does fundraising damage politicians, according to the summary?
a: Constant contact with wealthy donors disconnects them from ordinary citizens
Donors demand laws that are obviously illegal
Campaign spending decides who wins elections
Money must be reported to the public
questions.why: Lesson 2 says mixing with the top one percent makes it hard to stay connected to most voters.

questions.q: What solution does Obama propose for campaign funding?
a: Public funding and free airtime for presidential candidates
A strict cap on all private donations
Full disclosure of every donor's identity
Shorter campaigns limited to six weeks
questions.why: Lesson 2 offers public campaign financing and free media time as a way to reduce donor influence.

questions.q: Why can the current global fight not be won with weapons?
a: The enemy is extreme ideology, which only a social awakening can reform
Modern armies are too expensive to maintain
Other countries refuse to join coalitions
Weapons cannot reach remote regions
questions.why: Lesson 3 says today's threats are ideologies, and only change where they thrive can defeat them.
